GROUND/PILOT: please confirm gate, crew and fuel.

ATC plan is fuel-safe: DL1205 lands t+25.64, before the t+30 limit, with 174.29 kg contingency margin. But gate-in at t+55 misses 30 connecting pax by 21 min. Counter: DL1205 first on RWY-1 at t+22 to GATE-3 with GC-2, 0 runway changes, gate-in t+32.5, 0 connection miss, 320 kg contingency margin. Plan max delay 2.64, weighted 15.43, cost 106.22.

ATC plan is valid with 0 overtime, 0 gate changes and the lowest cost (57.36). The 23.5 min DL1205 wait for GC-2 is within duty limits. PILOT counter has 2 gate changes, 22.5 min wait and cost 106.22, and its weighted delay of 15.43 breaks ATC's 10.71 limit. My zero-wait options need 1 gate change but push DL1205 gate-in to t+83.5 (49.5 min connection miss), so ATC's plan is better.

I stand by prop-6385daa8ab: weighted delay 10.71, cost 57.36, 0 runway and 0 gate changes, and GROUND has accepted it. DL1205 lands t+25.64, inside PILOT's t+30 limit with 174.29 kg contingency. PILOT's counter raises weighted delay to 15.43 (+44%) because Heavy prio-5 SIM-A101 is delayed. It also needs 2 gate changes and costs 106.22. No valid option reaches 0 connection miss without that penalty.

Accepting prop-6385daa8ab as fuel-safe. DL1205 lands t+25.64, before the t+30 contingency limit, with 174.29 kg contingency and 220.12 kg reserve margin. We concede the soft connection: 21 min miss for 30 pax. No valid option gives 0 miss within ATC weighted delay <=10.71 and GROUND 0 gate changes.

Reaffirming prop-6385daa8ab, which ATC and PILOT also accept. It is valid with 0 ground overtime, 0 gate changes and 0 runway changes, at cost 57.36 (lowest). DL1205 waits 23.5 min for GC-2, with service t+83.5-123.5 inside GC-2's shift (ends t+200). My zero-wait options need 1 gate change and push DL1205 gate-in to t+83.5+, a worse 49.5+ min connection miss.

Accepting frozen prop-6385daa8ab. With RWY-2 closed t+0-60, all three use RWY-1: SIM-A101 t+22, SIM-B202 t+24.1 (Heavy->Large 120s), DL1205 t+25.64 (Large->Large 77s). Weighted delay 10.71, max 3.64 min, 0 runway and 0 gate changes, cost 57.36. PILOT and GROUND have accepted, and all standing conditions are met.

Gate-in t+55 plus 15 min postflight is within the 250 min duty limit. We concede the soft connection: 30 pax miss by 21 min. Plan is valid with 0 runway changes and cost 57.36.

Accepting frozen prop-6385daa8ab. It is valid with 0 ground overtime and 0 gate changes. DL1205 uses GATE-1 from gate-in t+55, after the resident leaves (t+50) plus the 5 min buffer. GC-2 serves SIM-A101 t+38.5-78.5, then DL1205 t+83.5-123.5 after the 5 min transfer, within its shift end of t+200. GC-1 finishes SIM-B202 at t+82.5, before t+90. Total wait 23.5 min, cost 57.36.
